{{TWMS}} was the first game in the series that allowed creating a playable character. The player could customize their name and appearance. Additonally, in version 1.1, it was possible to direct [[XP|development]] of the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer skills|skill tree]].

At the beginning of the game, the player had to create a playable character. One could choose between female and male body types and 4 ethnicities. These features were included in presets. In-depth customization, like changing hair and eye color, hair style or body shape, was not possible. However, the player could later change [[The Witcher Monster Slayer armor|armor]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer swords|weapon]] that the character used, which were displayed on the character menu screen. Avatars on the friends list included only default preset heads.

The player could name their character by typing the name themselves or by picking one from a set of predefined names. After the playable character had been created, it was impossible to edit them in any way.

==Notes==
* The game featured a system of blocking offensive phrases, which sometimes gave false positives. This caused some unassuming character names being labeled as offensive, because they included parts of banned words, e.g. ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hortense Hortense]''.
